summary: The filing is a preliminary prospectus supplement for a debt offering by Charles Schwab Corporation. The company is issuing three tranches of senior unsecured notes: fixed-to-floating rate notes due 2030 and 2037, and floating rate notes due 2030. Interest rates and spreads are not yet determined (shown as blanks). The notes rank equally with other unsecured senior debt and are not listed on any exchange. No special situation is present—this is a routine capital markets transaction.
